text:
Olivia Park: Heads-up — RacksCo emailed this morning. Our reserved GPU rack shipment (RESV-4821) has been moved out from 2026-05-10 to 2026-08-15. They blamed a firmware flash backlog and port congestion.
Sam Chen: Ugh. Is that for the whole order or just a subset?
Olivia Park: Whole order per their note. I've pasted their short timeline below.
Olivia Park: ```
RESV-4821: originally ETA 2026-05-10
new ETA: 2026-08-15
reason: firmware validation queue + intermodal delay
contact: laura@racksco.com
```
Maya Patel: @Olivia can you forward the vendor email to ops and customer success? We need to know which Dedicated customers this affects.
Olivia Park: Sent to ops and cs. Also pinged Zoe for sales visibility.
Zoe (sales): Thanks — I have two midmarket customers with Dedicated commitments in June. Need an updated mitigation plan from partnerships/ops ASAP.
Henry Gomez: Short-term options: 1) Borrow cloud marketplace quota from our partner cloud accounts for those customers, 2) Offer temporary hosted capacity (metered, higher price) while we wait, 3) Re-prioritize internal pool to cover critical SLAs. Which do we prefer?
Sam Chen: We should avoid SLA hits. Option 2 is easiest to stand up fast. What's the delta cost estimate per customer?
Maya Patel: I'll run numbers with finance, but we need signoff from sales on customer comms first. Zoe — can you draft a short note offering hosted fallback + credit? Keep it conservative.
Zoe (sales): Yep, draft in 30m. Will include opt-in to the temporary hosted route and estimated surcharge + credit.
Olivia Park: Also asked RacksCo for split shipments — they said it's technically possible but would incur extra freight & staging fees. They've given a partial ship ETA of 2026-06-20 for 40% of the order if we accept fees.
Henry Gomez: If partial ship is available, we should map that 40% to customers with the tightest latency SLOs. Ops — can you confirm if partial racks can be balanced into our cluster?
deploy-bot: NOTE: automated capacity planner suggests redistributing dynamic routes if partial racks are accepted; may increase cross-rack traffic by ~12%.
Sam Chen: Ops signoff required — @Maya can you loop in infra? If infra says ok, I prefer partial ship + hosted fallback for remaining capacity.
Maya Patel: Looping infra now. Also creating a shared spreadsheet to track impacted customers, mitigation chosen, and cost. Link: https://redwood.inc/warroom/resv-4821
Olivia Park: Action items: (1) Maya to get infra + finance numbers, (2) Zoe to send customer note with hosted fallback, (3) Olivia to negotiate split-shipment fees down, (4) Henry to draft internal routing plan if partials arrive.
Zoe (sales): I'll prep the customer note and share with partnerships for sign-off.
Sam Chen: Thanks everyone. Please update this thread when infra/finance confirm — we need to commit to a plan before EOD. :eyes:
Maya Patel: Will update by 17:30 PT.
Olivia Park: Thanks — tagging RacksCo contact again for pressure: laura@racksco.com :phone:
